title: "Same Energy"—A Visual Search Engine
content: Same Energyis a free website that describes itself a "visual search engine."On the home page you're presented with a wide assortment of images laid out in a tiled array. When you click on the image of your choice, it will find more images with the "same energy."The interface is fun for artists to use because it doesn't use words. It employs machine learning software to recognize similar looking images from a huge array that it finds on the web.You can use it to research photography styles, art subjects, interior decoration concepts or fashion trends.Same Energy website
